create_html_report: create an HTML report page with a title and auto-generated web and images directories
add_header_to_html: add a text header to the HTML document using the add_header method
add_images_to_html: add a row of clickable images with captions and hyperlinks to the HTML page
add_videos_to_html: add a row of clickable MP4 videos with captions and hyperlinks to the HTML page
save_html_to_disk: save the generated HTML document as index.html to the configured web directory
